literal_meaning: চাল (পদ্ধতি বা আচরণ) + চলন (চলাচল বা আচরণ)
example_sentences_in_bangla: তোমার চালচলন মোটেই ভালো ঠেকছে না।
এই চালচলন দেখে সবাই অবাক হয়ে গেল।
example_sentences_in_english: Your conduct doesn't seem good at all.
Everyone was surprised by this behavior.
note: This is a compound word often used idiomatically in Bengali to describe one's overall manner or conduct.
